---
title: "ocel env ref"
description: "Read a value stored elsewhere."
---

```bash
ocel env ref <KEY> [flags]
```

Read a value stored under another project, folder, or key.

Updates to the stored value reach every reference.

## Arguments

| Argument | Takes |
| --- | --- |
| `<KEY>` | Required |

## Flags

| Flag | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `--environment` | `string` |  | Use this named preview environment; requires `--preview` |
| `--folder` | `string` |  | Use the value in this folder |
| `--preview` | `bool` | `false` | Use preview values |
| `--target-folder` | `string` |  | Read from a folder in the target project |
| `--target-key` | `string` |  | Read a different target key |
| `--target-project` | `string` |  | Read from another project |

Every command also takes the [global flags](/docs/cli#global-flags).

## Behaviour

- Changes state.
- Prints data on stdout.
